Message.text: The Verge: ash-gray grass, old roads, and a long wind. A worn road runs north-east toward a Lantern at the crossroads. Lanterns are the safe places here; rest at each one you find.
A crossroads. East, the aqueduct and its steps. North-west, a windmill on a hill. And far to the north, above everything, a spire of woven light that no road seems to reach.
The Aqueduct Steps. The ramp climbs to the old water road, which runs to the chapel roof. A road also runs east to the Briar Thicket. Something large hunts in there: come back stronger.
Ninefold Chapel. Nine candles stood here once. The roof is gone, but one platform remains, and a ladder on its face is raised. Kick it down from above to link this Lantern to the aqueduct.
The crypt's far wall sounds hollow. Strike it with a swing to open it.
The windmill's sails are long gone. A ladder on its east face climbs to the roof, if you can get past what sleeps on this hill.
Mossgut Mouth. The cave behind is sealed by fallen rock. Beyond it, they say, a lift goes down to the deep.
The Briar Thicket. The hedges close in ahead. A fog hangs in the gap, thick and still. Whatever walks in the briars will not let you leave until one of you falls.
The Spire's base. Its door is a seam of woven light, shut. Come back when the great sigils are lit.
